A pin is set in a reviewed commit, together with the sources, never by a run. See docs/design/V3_LLM_PARITY_STAGE.md section 3.

model.note: The MODEL the earlier traces used (traces/llm_parity: Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct, HF snapshot c540970f9e29518b1d8f06ab8b24cba66ad77b6d, run through torch) in the one form ollama can load: a GGUF of the same model, fp16 to match the torch runs. The snapshot is a safetensors repository, so it is NOT the file to pin; the pin is one GGUF file (candidate, UNVERIFIED: Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF, qwen2-0_5b-instruct-fp16.gguf). Sources go here with the hash.

ollama.note: The ollama Linux amd64 release tarball (bin/ollama and lib/ollama/*), a .tgz because the arm unpacks it with Python's tarfile on both sides. The earlier traces ran no ollama at all, so no version is pinned in the repository; ollama_version above must be set with the hash and is compared with what the server reports.

virtiofsd.note: The Rust virtiofsd as ONE executable file, for the virtio-fs transport only (the 9p fallback does not need it). The Vast box image is Ubuntu 22.04 (glibc 2.35): INFERRED (no 22.04 archive was checked) that no Rust virtiofsd package exists there, and the Ubuntu 26.04 package needs glibc 2.39, so it must be fetched, as a build that runs on 2.35 (a static build).
